era: Late-2019 TikTok web (white design, Dec 2019 to early 2020): white 80px header with soft shadow, #fe2c55 accents, bold Sofia Pro names at 48px, grey 'Verified account' pill, 15px stats, grey bio, 8px-radius cards; the mid-2019 black trending page (s2) is the older variant

sources.shows: late-2019 profile (Wayback capture rendered offline, its own CSS in wb-profile-2019/): white 80px header with soft shadow (Home, About, Trending, Discover, menu), 48px sofiapro-bold name, 18px @handle with grey 'Verified account' pill, '860 Following 9.6m Followers 246.1m Likes' 15px, grey #8b8b91 bio, rule, Creators/Discover cards with pink See All, footer; no search, no log in, no follow or message buttons
mid-2019 trending page, older black variant (logo, Trending, language, menu, Trending Hashtags, Get the App)
profile screenshot dated 2020-01-03: round avatar left, 48px bold name, @handle with 'Verified account' pill, '135 Following 18.9M Followers 558.6M Likes', grey bio, rule

trending, hashtag, video modal and discover pages of the white web design (shown through a dark-mode extension, so layout only): header links Trending/Discover with pink underline, 3-column video cards with heart counts, Creators/Discover cards with See All, video modal with author, caption, '2.3M likes · 19.3K comments', share icons
mockup template of the then-current web profile and video page: header menu + logo + Trending/Discover, round avatar, bold name, stats, 3-column grid, Suggested accounts card, share icons

evidence: none of s1-s5 show a Following feed, messaging, Liked tab, LIVE, Explore, Friends, Shop, upload, coins, dramas, effects or photo posts on the web; all arrived 2020-2024
features.action: hidden (theme CSS and later labels); Photo search tab hidden by guard label

evidence: s1 and s3 (Dec 2019 / Jan 2020) show no search box, no log in and no follow button on the web; web search, log in and follow arrived in 2020
features.note: kept on purpose: hiding them would remove the only way to search, sign in or follow; the search page tabs (Top/Users/Videos), its Close control and the error-page Refresh belong to those flows
